summary: Exposes CHOP data from inside a component as one of the parent component's CHOP output connectors.
key_concepts: Out CHOP sends CHOP data from inside a component to an output connector on the parent component.
Each Out CHOP creates one CHOP output connector on its parent component.
The Label parameter controls the popup label shown on the parent component output connector.
Out CHOP is a component-interface operator, not a network or hardware output operator.
Common CHOP time-slice, sample-rate, scope, rename, and export behavior still affect data leaving the component.

key_params.name: label
key_params.note: Popup label for the parent component output connector

key_params.name: autoexportroot
key_params.note: Root for Channel Name is Path:Parameter exports

key_params.name: exporttable
key_params.note: DAT export table for DAT-index/name export methods

common_gotchas: Each Out CHOP creates one output connector on its parent component.
Out CHOP is for component interfaces, not network/protocol output.
The parent component's connector order depends on Out CHOP instances/order in the component.
Use a clear label when building reusable components so downstream users understand the output.
Sample-rate and time-slice settings still affect the data exported through the component connector.
